goal: Qualify a read-only PR-checking method using original Python regression tests from two external pull requests. Discover newly added tests with a generic Python AST differ, not manually authored per-PR test adapters.

protection: No changes to external upstream. No unsourced repair claims. If base not red or head not green, qualify UNKNOWN.
scope: Genuine external native regression and source-bound PR advice only; general autonomous generator invention remains UNKNOWN.
